description: A ten-step gate sequencer: each step can be switched on or off and given its own chance of firing, with a gate output per step and one output carrying the chosen steps

params.text: Switches that step on or off; the lamp beside it is lit while the step is on
Jumps the sequence straight to that step and holds both mixed outputs at 0V until the next clock pulse
Sets the chance that step fires when it comes round, from never at one end of the travel to always at the other

inputs.text: Each rise advances the sequence by one step and rolls the dice for the new step's probability
A rise returns the sequence to the first step and rolls its probability
Above 0V the sequence runs backwards, and at or below 0V forwards

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the sequence is on that step, whatever the step's switch and probability say, unless the menu is set to gate it by them
Carries a 10V gate for the first half of the clock beat when the current step is switched on and its probability roll succeeded
Carries a 10V gate for the first half of the clock beat when the current step is switched off, or is on but lost its probability roll

notes: nothing advances and the gate length stays unknown until a clock is patched; the beat length is measured from the gap between the last two clock pulses
menu: Active step outputs to Gate output — makes each per-step gate follow that step's on switch and its probability roll, rather than only marking where the sequence is

inputs.2:
high above 0V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
